# KAppMaker CLI

> Command reference for the KAppMaker CLI: create a Kotlin Multiplatform project, configure
> Firebase, build signed releases and ship to the App Store and Google Play. This is the tool the
> KAppMaker AI agent drives on your behalf. See https://kappmaker.com.

The CLI is installed with `npm i -g kappmaker` and runs standalone, but it is also the toolchain
behind [KAppMaker AI](https://kappmaker.com): a cloud machine that runs Claude Code non-stop and
takes instructions over Telegram, so an app gets built while its owner sleeps. Every command below
is one an agent can run unattended — no Xcode, no Android Studio, no Mac required for iOS.

## Start here

- [Introduction and install](https://cli.kappmaker.com/): what the CLI does and how to install it
- [Configuration](https://cli.kappmaker.com/configuration): the config file, API keys and defaults
- [Claude Code skill](https://cli.kappmaker.com/guides/claude-code-skill): the routed skills that let
  Claude Code drive the CLI
- [Per-app checklist](https://cli.kappmaker.com/guides/per-app-checklist): zero to published, in order

## Project setup

- [create](https://cli.kappmaker.com/project-setup/create): scaffold a new Kotlin Multiplatform app
- [clone](https://cli.kappmaker.com/project-setup/clone): start from the KAppMaker boilerplate
- [refactor](https://cli.kappmaker.com/project-setup/refactor): rename the package and app
- [firebase](https://cli.kappmaker.com/project-setup/firebase): create the project and wire configs
- [update-version](https://cli.kappmaker.com/project-setup/update-version): bump marketing and build numbers
- [git setup](https://cli.kappmaker.com/project-setup/git-setup-upstream): origin and upstream remotes

## Store publishing

- [publish](https://cli.kappmaker.com/store-publishing/publish): ship to TestFlight, the App Store or Google Play
- [create-appstore-app](https://cli.kappmaker.com/store-publishing/create-appstore-app): create the App Store Connect record
- [Google Play Console](https://cli.kappmaker.com/store-publishing/google-play-console): set up and push to Play
- [quick-add](https://cli.kappmaker.com/store-publishing/quick-add): add subscriptions and in-app purchases
- [RevenueCat](https://cli.kappmaker.com/store-publishing/revenuecat-setup) / [Adapty](https://cli.kappmaker.com/store-publishing/adapty-setup): paywall backends

## Build and signing

- [Ship iOS without a Mac](https://cli.kappmaker.com/build-signing/ios-without-a-mac): build, sign and
  upload from Linux or Windows on a GitHub macOS runner
- [Android release build](https://cli.kappmaker.com/build-signing/android-release-build)
- [generate-keystore](https://cli.kappmaker.com/build-signing/generate-keystore)
- [fastlane configure](https://cli.kappmaker.com/build-signing/fastlane-configure)
